  85 │ function runFfmpeg(executable, args) {
  86 │   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  87 │     const child = spawn(executable, args, { windowsHide: true })
  88 │     let error = ''
  89 │     child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => { error += chunk.toString() })
  90 │     child.on('error', reject)
  91 │     child.on('close', (code) => code === 0 ? resolve() : reject(new Error(error.slice(-1200) || `FFmpeg 退出码：${code}`)))
  92 │   })
  93 │ }

 103 │ function resolveExistingVfsFile(vfsPath) {
 104 │   const direct = fsUtils.validatePath(vfsPath)
 105 │   if (fs.existsSync(direct)) return direct
 106 │   const wanted = path.basename(vfsPath || '')
 107 │   const root = fsUtils.validatePath('/')
 108 │   const queue = [root]
 109 │   let scanned = 0
 110 │   while (queue.length && scanned < 8000) {
 111 │     const dir = queue.shift()
 112 │     let entries = []
 113 │     try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }) } catch (_) { continue }
 114 │     for (const entry of entries) {
 115 │       scanned += 1
 116 │       const candidate = path.join(dir, entry.name)
 117 │       if (entry.isFile() && entry.name === wanted) {
 118 │         console.warn(`[nativeCompose] 兼容旧素材路径：${vfsPath} -> ${candidate}`)
 119 │         return candidate
 120 │       }
 121 │       if (entry.isDirectory() && !entry.name.startsWith('.') && scanned < 8000) queue.push(candidate)
 122 │     }
 123 │   }
 124 │   throw new Error(`找不到素材文件：${vfsPath}（已检查 ${direct} 和本地素材库）`)
 125 │ }

 127 │ function assTime(seconds) {
 128 │   const value = Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0)
 129 │   const hours = Math.floor(value / 3600)
 130 │   const minutes = Math.floor((value % 3600) / 60)
 131 │   const secs = Math.floor(value % 60)
 132 │   const centis = Math.round((value - Math.floor(value)) * 100)
 133 │   return `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}.${String(centis).padStart(2, '0')}`

 136 │ function wrapSubtitleText(text, maxCharsPerLine) {
 137 │   const limit = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(maxCharsPerLine) || 18))
 138 │   return String(text || '').replace(/\r/g, '').split('\n').flatMap((paragraph) => {
 139 │     const chars = Array.from(paragraph)
 140 │     if (!chars.length) return ['']
 141 │     const lines = []
 142 │     for (let index = 0; index < chars.length; index += limit) lines.push(chars.slice(index, index + limit).join(''))
 143 │     return lines
 144 │   }).join('\n')
 145 │ }

 151 │ function assColor(value, fallback) {
 152 │   const input = String(value || '').trim()
 153 │   const hex = input.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i)
 154 │   if (hex) {
 155 │     const rgb = hex[1]
 156 │     return `&H00${rgb.slice(4, 6)}${rgb.slice(2, 4)}${rgb.slice(0, 2)}`
 157 │   }
 158 │   const rgba = input.match(/^rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)(?:\s*,\s*([\d.]+))?\s*\)$/i)
 159 │   if (!rgba) return fallback
 160 │   const [, red, green, blue, opacity = '1'] = rgba
 161 │   const alpha = Math.round((1 - Math.min(1, Math.max(0, Number(opacity)))) * 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0').toUpperCase()
 162 │   return `&H${alpha}${Number(blue).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Number(green).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}${Number(red).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}`.toUpperCase()

+export const relayUpload = async (
+  file,
+  filename,
+  purpose = 'input',
+  { signal, apiBaseUrl, apiKey } = {},
+) => {
+  const baseUrl = (apiBaseUrl || getBaseUrl()).replace(/\/$/, '');
+  const formData = new FormData();
+  formData.append('file', file, filename);
+  formData.append('purpose', purpose);
+
+  const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v1/uploads/relay`, {
+    method: 'POST',
+    headers: {
+      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey || getApiKey()}`,
+    },
+    body: formData,
+    signal,
+  });
+  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
+  if (!response.ok || (payload.code !== undefined && payload.code !== 0 && payload.code !== 200)) {
+    const message = payload?.message || payload?.detail || `文件上传失败（HTTP ${response.status}）`;
+    throw new Error(message);
+  }
+  return payload;
+};

+function buildComposePlan(clips, mediaFiles, sceneFilesMap) {
+  const sourceClips = clips
+    .filter((clip) => ['human', 'video'].includes(clip.type))
+    .sort((a, b) => a.start_ms - b.start_ms)
+  const sceneClips = clips
+    .filter((clip) => clip.type === 'scene')
+    .sort((a, b) => a.start_ms - b.start_ms)
+
+  const segments = []
+  const partFiles = []
+  sourceClips.forEach((clip, index) => {
+    const startMs = Math.max(0, Number(clip.start_ms) || 0)
+    const durationMs = Math.max(1, Number(clip.duration_ms) || 1)
+    const endMs = startMs + durationMs
+    const sceneClip = sceneClips.find((candidate) => (
+      candidate.start_ms <= startMs
+      && candidate.start_ms + candidate.duration_ms >= endMs
+    ))
+    const sourceBlob = mediaFileRegistry.get(clip.mediaId)
+    if (!sourceBlob) return
+
+    const sceneMedia = sceneClip ? mediaFiles[sceneClip.mediaId] : null
+    const sceneBlob = sceneClip ? mediaFileRegistry.get(sceneClip.mediaId) : null
+    const scenePath = sceneMedia?.vfsPath || sceneMedia?.name || sceneClip?.scene_vfs_path || sceneClip?.scene_file || ''
+    if (sceneClip && sceneBlob && scenePath && sceneFilesMap) {
+      sceneFilesMap[scenePath] = sceneBlob
+      if (sceneMedia?.name) sceneFilesMap[sceneMedia.name] = sceneBlob
+    }
+
+    segments.push({
+      id: clip.id || `compose_segment_${index + 1}`,
+      type: sceneClip && sceneBlob ? 'scene' : 'human',
+      start_ms: startMs,
+      end_ms: endMs,
+      duration_ms: durationMs,

+      source_segment_id: clip.source_segment_id || null,
+      char_start: clip.char_start,
+      char_end: clip.char_end,
+    })
+    partFiles.push(sourceBlob)
+  })
+
+  return {
+    timeline: {

+  }

+function getActiveSubtitle(project, currentTimeMs) {
+  const segments = Array.isArray(project?.segments)
+    ? project.segments
+    : Array.isArray(project?.timeline?.segments) ? project.timeline.segments : []
+  const segment = segments.find((item) => {
+    const start = Number(item.start_ms ?? Number(item.start || 0) * 1000)
+    const end = Number(item.end_ms ?? Number(item.end || 0) * 1000)
+    return currentTimeMs >= start && currentTimeMs < end
+  })
+  if (!segment) return null
+
+  const allCharacters = Array.isArray(project?.char_timings) ? project.char_timings : []
+  const charStart = Number.isFinite(Number(segment.char_start)) ? Number(segment.char_start) : null
+  const charEnd = Number.isFinite(Number(segment.char_end)) ? Number(segment.char_end) : null
+  const characters = allCharacters.length > 0
+    ? allCharacters.filter((character) => {
+        const index = Number(character.index)
+        if (charStart !== null && index < charStart) return false
+        if (charEnd !== null && index > charEnd) return false
+        return true
+      })
+    : String(segment.text || segment.content || '').split('').map((char, index) => ({ char, index }))
+  if (!characters.length) return null
+
+  const activeCharacter = allCharacters.find((character) => {
+    const start = Number(character.start_ms ?? Number(character.start || 0) * 1000)
+    const end = Number(character.end_ms ?? Number(character.end || 0) * 1000)
+    return currentTimeMs >= start && currentTimeMs < end
+  })
+  return {
+    chars: characters.map((character) => ({
+      ...character,
+      char: character.char ?? character.text ?? '',
+      active: activeCharacter ? Number(character.index) === Number(activeCharacter.index) : false,

+        materialMs: null,

+      })
+      return
+    }

+        segmentId: segment.id || `scene_${index + 1}`,
+        materialName,
+        requiredMs,
+        materialMs,
+        loopCount: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(requiredMs / materialMs) - 1),
+        message: `${materialName} 时长 ${(materialMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} 秒，模板段需要 ${(requiredMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} 秒，将循环播放。`,

+    }
+  })
+

+    materialDurationMs: sceneSegments.reduce(

+function buildComposePlan(clips, mediaFiles, sceneFilesMap) {
+  const sourceClips = clips
+    .filter((clip) => ['human', 'video'].includes(clip.type))
+    .sort((a, b) => a.start_ms - b.start_ms)
+  const sceneClips = clips
+    .filter((clip) => clip.type === 'scene')
+    .sort((a, b) => a.start_ms - b.start_ms)
+
+  const segments = []
+  const partFiles = []
+  sourceClips.forEach((clip, index) => {
+    const startMs = Math.max(0, Number(clip.start_ms) || 0)
+    const durationMs = Math.max(1, Number(clip.duration_ms) || 1)
+    const endMs = startMs + durationMs
+    const sceneClip = sceneClips.find((candidate) => (
+      candidate.start_ms <= startMs
+      && candidate.start_ms + candidate.duration_ms >= endMs
+    ))
+    const sourceBlob = mediaFileRegistry.get(clip.mediaId)
+    if (!sourceBlob) return
+
+    const sceneMedia = sceneClip ? mediaFiles[sceneClip.mediaId] : null
+    const sceneBlob = sceneClip ? mediaFileRegistry.get(sceneClip.mediaId) : null
+    const scenePath = sceneMedia?.vfsPath || sceneMedia?.name || sceneClip?.scene_vfs_path || sceneClip?.scene_file || ''
+    if (sceneClip && sceneBlob && scenePath && sceneFilesMap) {
+      sceneFilesMap[scenePath] = sceneBlob
+      if (sceneMedia?.name) sceneFilesMap[sceneMedia.name] = sceneBlob
+    }
+
+    segments.push({
+      id: clip.id || `compose_segment_${index + 1}`,
+      type: sceneClip && sceneBlob ? 'scene' : 'human',
+      start_ms: startMs,
+      end_ms: endMs,
+      duration_ms: durationMs,
+      start: startMs / 1000,
+      end: endMs / 1000,

+      source_segment_id: clip.source_segment_id || null,
+      char_start: clip.char_start,
+      char_end: clip.char_end,
+    })
+    partFiles.push(sourceBlob)
+  })
+
+  return {
+    timeline: {
+      schema: 'rjcut.advanced-compose/v1',

+function getActiveSubtitle(project, currentTimeMs) {
+  const segments = Array.isArray(project?.segments)
+    ? project.segments
+    : Array.isArray(project?.timeline?.segments) ? project.timeline.segments : []
+  const segment = segments.find((item) => {
+    const start = Number(item.start_ms ?? Number(item.start || 0) * 1000)
+    const end = Number(item.end_ms ?? Number(item.end || 0) * 1000)
+    return currentTimeMs >= start && currentTimeMs < end
+  })
+  if (!segment) return null
+
+  const allCharacters = Array.isArray(project?.char_timings) ? project.char_timings : []
+  const charStart = Number.isFinite(Number(segment.char_start)) ? Number(segment.char_start) : null
+  const charEnd = Number.isFinite(Number(segment.char_end)) ? Number(segment.char_end) : null
+  const characters = allCharacters.length > 0
+    ? allCharacters.filter((character) => {
+        const index = Number(character.index)
+        if (charStart !== null && index < charStart) return false
+        if (charEnd !== null && index > charEnd) return false
+        return true
+      })
+    : String(segment.text || segment.content || '').split('').map((char, index) => ({ char, index }))
+  if (!characters.length) return null
+
+  const activeCharacter = allCharacters.find((character) => {
+    const start = Number(character.start_ms ?? Number(character.start || 0) * 1000)
+    const end = Number(character.end_ms ?? Number(character.end || 0) * 1000)
+    return currentTimeMs >= start && currentTimeMs < end
+  })
+  return {
+    chars: characters.map((character) => ({
+      ...character,
+      char: character.char ?? character.text ?? '',
+      active: activeCharacter ? Number(character.index) === Number(activeCharacter.index) : false,
+    })),
+  }
+}

+  const templateDurationMs = segments.reduce(

+    0,
+  )

+    const requiredMs = Math.max(0, Number(segment.end_ms) - Number(segment.start_ms))
+    const materialMs = Number(segment.material_duration_ms)
+    const materialName = segment.scene_file || segment.scene_vfs_path
+    if (!Number.isFinite(materialMs) || materialMs <= 0) {
+      warnings.push({

+        segmentId: segment.id || `scene_${index + 1}`,
+        materialName,
+        requiredMs,
+        materialMs: null,
+        message: `${materialName} 未读取到时长，合成时将按循环模式补足。`,
+      })
+      return
+    }
+    if (materialMs + 100 < requiredMs) {
+      warnings.push({
+        type: 'loop',
+        segmentId: segment.id || `scene_${index + 1}`,
+        materialName,
+        requiredMs,
+        materialMs,
+        loopCount: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(requiredMs / materialMs) - 1),
+        message: `${materialName} 时长 ${(materialMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} 秒，模板段需要 ${(requiredMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} 秒，将循环播放。`,
+      })
+    }
+  })
+
+  return {
+    templateDurationMs,
+    materialDurationMs: sceneSegments.reduce(
+      (sum, segment) => sum + (Number(segment.material_duration_ms) > 0 ? Number(segment.material_duration_ms) : 0),
+      0,
+    ),
+    sceneCount: sceneSegments.length,
+    warnings,
+    willLoop: warnings.some((warning) => warning.type === 'loop' || warning.type === 'unknown'),
+  }
